label: Heavy going
summary: The Iran war still dominated. President Trump said the US was weighing a strike on Iran as early as Sunday but did not rule out a deal. Houthi forces attacked Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Aden, and Israeli raids forced more than 2,000 people from their homes in Hebron. Gunmen killed at least 10 people in Nigeria's Taraba State. Hundreds of thousands marched in France over the cost of living, and US consumer sentiment fell to near-record lows. An earthquake in Tibet killed 16 people. There was some relief. A tsunami warning for Vanuatu was lifted, Brazil held a peaceful presidential runoff, New York's archdiocese agreed an $800m settlement with abuse survivors, the US gained a new national park, and Bennu asteroid samples yielded new findings. The weighted formula gave 39; no editorial adjustment.
